_doc: Surface library for wheeled robots with ordinary (pneumatic or lugged) tyres, built for the Clearpath Husky A200 (drive.sh --surface-file configs/surfaces_husky.json); any robot can use it. Entries extend the base library of configs/calibrated_params.json through "base" (hard surfaces: base table, no Bekker layer; soils: a full Bekker-Janosi set). Groups: hard, soil, intermediate (synthetic interpolation between two sourced entries), fitted (calibrated on recorded runs of a real Husky). Every entry says where each number comes from in _src: [H] handbook / literature value, [F] fitted on recorded runs of the real robot, [E] estimate inside a physically plausible range, [S] synthetic. Units: kc N/m^(n+1), kphi N/m^(n+2), c Pa, K m.
_spread_doc: cv_res / cv_grip / cv_soil / corr_len: spatial heterogeneity of every surface, identified on recorded Husky runs (fluctuation of the side motor currents around their 1 s mean) per surface class (fitted entries) or per group (hard: s = 1.25, soils: s = 2, snow: s = 3 times the Robotino-calibrated spread, correlation length L = 0.1-0.2 m).

_sources.wong_adhesion: J.Y. Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, 4th ed., Wiley 2008, Table 1.3 (average peak and sliding tyre-road adhesion coefficients)
_sources.wong_rolling: J.Y. Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, Table 1.1 (rolling resistance coefficients of car tyres on various surfaces)
_sources.wong_soils: J.Y. Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, Table 2.3 (n, kc, kphi, c, phi of terrains); n, kc, kphi cross-checked with Han et al. 2014, Trans. CSAE 30(11):45, Table 4
_sources.marssim: MarsSim soil, Table II of the MarsSim paper (as in configs/calibrated_params.json, mars_soil)
_sources.fit: calibration on recorded runs of a Husky A200: BorealTC (LaRocque et al., IROS 2024) and RoboNav route 2 (Eder et al., 2023), fitting halves only
